name: conversation-data-visualization
description: Produces bounded exploratory data visuals with recoverable values and calibrated interpretation in a conversation. Applies when a human and AI are examining data together and a figure can change the next question or decision.

contract.what: A compact exploratory visual and evidence companion suited to the current conversational question.
when: A shared data exploration needs a pattern, comparison, distribution, uncertainty, or relationship made visible before committing to a durable publication.
boundaries: The human's delivery preference and available tools govern the carrier. Data access grants analysis within the task, while external upload, hosting, publication, and new persistent services retain their own authority. A conversational figure's polish remains separate from evidentiary standing.
contract.result: A useful figure or simpler alternative, a concise interpretation, and enough source/value context to continue or correct the exploration.

receivingUse.job: A shared data exploration needs a pattern, comparison, distribution, uncertainty, or relationship made visible before committing to a durable publication.
receivingUse.materialResult: A useful figure or simpler alternative, a concise interpretation, and enough source/value context to continue or correct the exploration.
receivingUse.completion: The receiving collaborator can locate the semantic source, work within its boundaries, and recognize the material result.

standing.evidenceMaturity: Repository-maintained portable contract with source-specific, revisable material-use evidence.
standing.wakeTrigger: Material use, human correction, receiving-artifact behavior, or independent evidence changes this route.

transferBoundary: This projection carries repository-local instruction yield. Current intent, repository evidence, and granted tool authority govern each activation.
